description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI in the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It contains setup methods, data providers, and test cases for API endpoints related to employee attendance summaries, including test methods for 'getAll', 'create', 'delete', and validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI, focusing on testing the 'getAll' endpoint and ensuring that 'create', 'delete', and their validation methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data by populating necessary YAML fixtures before any tests run.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API method with different test cases provided by a data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case parameters for 'testGetAll' from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'create' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that 'delete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
